description: This source file defines a logging utility with log levels, a Logger class, and an extension for initializing log levels from string configurations. It provides functionality for different levels of logging such as trace, debug, info, warn, and error, with timestamped output.

classes.name: Logger
classes.description: A struct that provides logging functionality with different levels and timestamped output.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specific log level if it meets the current logging level threshold.
